title: Data and code for Characterisation and Quantification of Data Centre Flexibility for Power System Support
description: Adopted workload and electricity-price inputs, computational model and retained outputs supporting an integrated assessment of data centre flexibility. The archive includes fourteen linked annual scenario chains for 2025, a 288-cell representative-day flexibility grid, 148 positive-duration event dispatches, numerical accounting and checkpoint audits, and reproducibility instructions. The central annual electricity cost saving is 5.38%. Workloads are stylised assumptions, and durations are certified feasible values subject to documented assessment caps and unresolved trials. No service revenue or network-stability validation is implied.
rights_note: Authors must select the repository licence, respecting third-party LCCC price-data terms. No licence has been inferred.
